title: Home practical guide and safety card: cress test
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Skeletons, muscles, nutrition and plants (Tribal Tales)
source: Written for science/y3 lesson 21 (Home practical guide and safety card: cress test (portal worksheet; adult chooses the spots, wash hands after))
intro: Lesson 21: Setting up the cress test and plant diary. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out what cress seeds need to grow well
equipment: A cupboard and a sunny windowsill
safety: Adult chooses the spots, wash hands after
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Put damp kitchen paper in each saucer
Sprinkle the same number of seeds on each
An adult chooses the spots: 1 light and watered, 2 dark and watered, 3 light and dry, 4 cold and watered
Water saucers 1, 2 and 4 a little each day
Measure or describe the cress every two days for ten days
Wash your hands after touching the seeds

questions.q: Seeds starting to grow is called...
Big question: how will we know if our prediction was right?
questions.a: By measuring and recording each pot in the diary and comparing them.
